sponsors: Rep. Alex Valdez, Rep. Monica Duran, Sen. Kyle Mullica
status: Postponed indefinitely by House Energy and Environment Committee (vote 11-2) 2026-05-07
key_provisions: Creates a data center development and incentive program with a 100 percent state sales/use tax exemption for certified data centers, a 250 million dollar minimum investment threshold, job and labor commitments, utility consultation, water stewardship, backup power requirements, and targeted resource acquisition authority.

status: Postponed indefinitely by House Energy and Environment Committee (vote 8-5) 2026-04-30
key_provisions: Would authorize consumer-regulated electric utilities to serve new nonresidential loads, including data centers, outside ordinary public utility regulation unless they interconnect with a regulated utility service territory.

sponsors: Sen. Nick Hinrichsen, Sen. Paul Lundeen, Rep. Kyle Brown, Rep. Alex Valdez
status: Laid over unamended (amendments failed) in Senate Appropriations Committee 2025-05-08; bill died with adjournment of the 2025 session
key_provisions: Would have created the Colorado Data Center Development and Grid Modernization Act, including certification tiers, sales/use tax exemptions, grid enhancement credits, utility consultation, renewable/clean energy commitments, water stewardship, and annual compliance reports.

sponsors: Sen. Cathy Kipp, Rep. Kyle Brown
status: Postponed indefinitely by Senate Transportation and Energy Committee (vote 9-0) 2026-05-11
key_provisions: Regulates "large-load data centers" above 30 MW individual peak load or 60 MW collective load; includes renewable energy and hourly matching rules, water/electricity reporting, infrastructure cost contracts, model codes, site assessments, cumulative impact analysis, public engagement, community benefit agreements, and labor standards.
